Name: More Mushrooms for Stardew Valley
Author: Syanide23
Description:
[b]For 1.6 please use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29752]More Mushrooms (1.6)[/url][/b]

Adds 20 more forgeable mushrooms to the game. There are five for each season and all of the mushrooms are based on real fungi. They should appear where most forgeables appear.

Spring:
﻿Button Mushroom
﻿Black Trumpet Mushroom
﻿Mica Cap Mushroom
﻿Oyster Mushroom
﻿Reishi Mushroom

Summer:
﻿Destroying Angel Mushroom
﻿Wood Blewit Mushroom
﻿Giant Puffball Mushroom
﻿Lion's Mane Mushroom
﻿Hedgehog Mushroom

Fall:
﻿Chicken Of The Woods Mushroom
﻿Death Cap Mushroom
﻿Lobster Mushroom
﻿Shaggy Mane Mushroom
﻿Maitake Mushroom

Winter:
﻿Brick Cap Mushroom
﻿Chaga Mushroom
﻿Winter Mushrom
﻿Wood Ear Mushroom
﻿Velvet Shank Mushroom

Downloads.Description: Fixed an issue with the winter mushrooms not spawning and adjusted the sell price of some mushrooms.
